dct_creator_sm: B.C. Ministry of Environment (Province of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm:
The complete archive of the B.C. Ministry of Environment EQUIS Database materials is available at the University of Victoria Libraries Special Collections and University Archives (AR 379 ; Accession # 2002-050).

Archived materials include:

- Administrative files describing the EQUIS program, including data entry, report generation, and calculation procedures

- Two CDs with copies of data used to create this dataset

- One tape reel (AMPEX 836/1600 CPI) of original data copied from EQUIS

- Printed files of test result data output from the EQUIS database

- Microfiche files of test result data output from the EQUIS database, sequenced according to test site

*** PLEASE NOTE *** In case of errors introduced during the migration process from the original EQUIS database to this present dataset, these data may be verified against the archived microfiche files. It is recommended that reconstructions of the EQUIS database using this dataset be verified against the archived microfiche files.

Pollution monitoring data recorded in the B.C. Ministry of Environment Environmental Quality Information System (EQUIS). Data files include inventories of effluent releases, air emissions, and refuse discharges recorded from more than 15,000 locations throughout the Province of British Columbia between the mid-1960s to mid-1980s, in regulation with the B.C. Pollution Control Act, 1967.

In 1971, the Province of British Columbia developed a purpose-built computer data storage and retrieval system, known as EQUIS, to manage information related to their permitting system regulating discharges of pollutants to land, air, and water, under the B.C. Pollution Control Act, 1967. Site data describing geographic and administrative information, including permit conditions, are recorded in relation to scientific test result data recording water quality, air quality, and taxonomic information.

EQUIS was archived in 2002 and the data and metadata contained were exported into flat text files for long term preservation. This dataset presents these files, which are organized according to site data, test result data, and biological data. Related metadata include data documentation, code tables, and data dictionaries, which are necessary for interpreting data files and reconstructing EQUIS database outputs.
